pretreatment: RCA cleaning (SC-1) procedure to remove organic contaminants, followed by a 1% hydrofluoric acid dip for 20 s to reduce native oxide down to ∼0.6 nm on Si surface
evidence: Prior to deposition, Si (15 mm× 20 mm) samples were cleaned with the Radio Corporation of America (RCA) standard cleaning (SC-1) procedure to remove organic contaminants, followed by a 1% hydrofluoric acid dip for 20 s to reduce native oxide down to ∼0.6 nm on Si surface.
